trigger: User-selected molecular region plus molecular geometry/symmetry; for steering, targets captured from a prior interactive trajectory.
assistance_that_changes: The system computes least-occluded viewpoints and constrained camera paths; TargetSystem later changes emitted forces as the complex advances through captured targets.
exact_evidence_passage: “compute the least occluded position ... [from] an area identified by the user” and “automatically steer ... based on a user defined path.”
evidence_locator: ExaViz HAL report pp. 11 and 14–15; §§4.1.2 and 5.1.1.
why_beyond_ordinary_execution: The system selects a viewpoint/path from data geometry and interaction history rather than merely applying a user-entered camera value or force.
implemented_vs_proposed: Implemented and exercised on desktop. Broader environment-level adaptation described in the conclusion remains future work and is not used.
approval_status: Automated boundary audit; author approval pending

trigger: The same selected molecular target, geometry, symmetry, and captured steering history in the implemented CAVE-like environment.
assistance_that_changes: Viewpoint/path guidance and automated steering forces change with the target, current molecular position, and prior interaction path.
exact_evidence_passage: The navigation paradigms were tested “in a desktop as well as in a Cave-like virtual environment.”
why_beyond_ordinary_execution: The system derives guidance and actions from task/data context and interaction history; the CAVE display itself is not the Adaptive evidence.
implemented_vs_proposed: Implemented CAVE-like navigation and steering. General future claims of richer dynamic adaptation are excluded.
approval_status: Automated boundary audit; author approval pending

trigger: The currently selected patient slice together with the spoken target/pathology request.
assistance_that_changes: Real-time RAG selects anatomically similar positive/negative references and generates query-specific, patient-grounded guidance.
exact_evidence_passage: “query-specific guidance based on the user’s spoken prompt and the current image slice.”
evidence_locator: SAMIRA arXiv:2505.07214v3 pp. 9–10; §4.3 and Fig. 5. Implementation stack also documented on p. 4.
why_beyond_ordinary_execution: The response content and reference set are system-selected from current visual/task context. Point-prompt mask refinement alone is not treated as Adaptive.
implemented_vs_proposed: Implemented and included in the full workflow study. Skill-level adaptation is explicitly future work and is excluded.
approval_status: Automated boundary audit; author approval pending

trigger: The user optionally enables a local-resolution cut-off or opacity weighting.
assistance_that_changes: A fixed mapping masks or weights heatmap values using precomputed local resolution.
exact_evidence_passage: “If enabled, the cut-off threshold determines the visibility ... [or] local resolution factors ... mapped to opacity.”
evidence_locator: Author manuscript p. 6; §4.3, lines 541–552 in the paged extraction; Fig. 3 on p. 5.
why_beyond_ordinary_execution: Not established. The report shows optional, user-enabled data-driven encoding, but no system-selected dynamic tailoring based on changing task, behavior, history, or inferred intent.
implemented_vs_proposed: The weighting is implemented; the qualifying Adaptive mechanism is not demonstrated.
approval_status: Automated boundary audit; author approval pending

trigger: Extracted entity semantic type, source structure, clinical relevance, and currentness of the patient data.
assistance_that_changes: The system automatically selects suitable visualization modules and orders current medication/data modules.
exact_evidence_passage: “each component is selected automatically to match the task and data characteristics.”
evidence_locator: Published report p. 8, Interactive visual representation; mapping formalization pp. 8–9; functional-core statement p. 13.
why_beyond_ordinary_execution: The system chooses the visual representation from data/task characteristics; the user does not merely pick a chart or enter a parameter.
implemented_vs_proposed: Core extraction, mapping, and dashboard components are reported functional. Diagnosis/user-context adaptation on p. 14 is future work and is excluded.
approval_status: Automated boundary audit; author approval pending
